11: // TestTranslateConsumerConfig covers task 3.2 of
12: // openspec/changes/ahab-jetstream-deadletter-fix. It pins the cluster
13: // ConsumerConfig → jetstream.ConsumerConfig translation so a future
14: // contributor who refactors nats_transport.go cannot silently drop the
15: // FilterSubject plumb-through (or drop any of the other defaults
16: // without the regression surfacing in a fast unit test). The
17: // integration test `TestAhabBootDeadLetter` is the outer guard; this
18: // test is the inner one that fails in milliseconds instead of seconds.
19: func TestTranslateConsumerConfig(t *testing.T) {
20: 	tests := []struct {
21: 		name string
22: 		in   ConsumerConfig
23: 		want jetstream.ConsumerConfig
24: 	}{
25: 		{
26: 			name: "zero-value ConsumerConfig applies defaults and leaves FilterSubject empty",
27: 			in:   ConsumerConfig{},
28: 			want: jetstream.ConsumerConfig{
29: 				Durable:       "",
30: 				AckWait:       30 * time.Second,
31: 				MaxDeliver:    3,
32: 				AckPolicy:     jetstream.AckExplicitPolicy,
33: 				FilterSubject: "",
34: 			},
35: 		},
36: 		{
37: 			name: "durable-only ConsumerConfig (ahab-workers call-site shape) preserves empty FilterSubject",
38: 			in: ConsumerConfig{
39: 				Durable: ConsumerAhabWorkers,
40: 			},
41: 			want: jetstream.ConsumerConfig{
42: 				Durable:       ConsumerAhabWorkers,
43: 				AckWait:       30 * time.Second,
44: 				MaxDeliver:    3,
45: 				AckPolicy:     jetstream.AckExplicitPolicy,
46: 				FilterSubject: "",
47: 			},
48: 		},
49: 		{
50: 			name: "DLQ-shape ConsumerConfig plumbs FilterSubject through verbatim",
51: 			in: ConsumerConfig{
52: 				Durable:       "ahab-tasks-deadletter",
53: 				FilterSubject: "ahab.deadletter",
54: 			},
55: 			want: jetstream.ConsumerConfig{
56: 				Durable:       "ahab-tasks-deadletter",
57: 				AckWait:       30 * time.Second,
58: 				MaxDeliver:    3,
59: 				AckPolicy:     jetstream.AckExplicitPolicy,
60: 				FilterSubject: "ahab.deadletter",
61: 			},
62: 		},
63: 		{
64: 			name: "explicit AckWait and MaxDeliver override the defaults",
65: 			in: ConsumerConfig{
66: 				Durable:       "custom",
67: 				AckWait:       5 * time.Second,
68: 				MaxDeliver:    7,
69: 				FilterSubject: "ahab.deadletter",
70: 			},
71: 			want: jetstream.ConsumerConfig{
72: 				Durable:       "custom",
73: 				AckWait:       5 * time.Second,
74: 				MaxDeliver:    7,
75: 				AckPolicy:     jetstream.AckExplicitPolicy,
76: 				FilterSubject: "ahab.deadletter",
77: 			},
78: 		},
79: 	}
80: 
81: 	for _, tt := range tests {
82: 		tt := tt
83: 		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
84: 			got := translateConsumerConfig(tt.in)
85: 			if got.Durable != tt.want.Durable {
86: 				t.Errorf("Durable = %q, want %q", got.Durable, tt.want.Durable)
87: 			}
88: 			if got.AckWait != tt.want.AckWait {
89: 				t.Errorf("AckWait = %v, want %v", got.AckWait, tt.want.AckWait)
90: 			}
91: 			if got.MaxDeliver != tt.want.MaxDeliver {
92: 				t.Errorf("MaxDeliver = %d, want %d", got.MaxDeliver, tt.want.MaxDeliver)
93: 			}
94: 			if got.AckPolicy != tt.want.AckPolicy {
95: 				t.Errorf("AckPolicy = %v, want %v", got.AckPolicy, tt.want.AckPolicy)
96: 			}
97: 			if got.FilterSubject != tt.want.FilterSubject {
98: 				t.Errorf("FilterSubject = %q, want %q (the plumb-through this test guards)", got.FilterSubject, tt.want.FilterSubject)
99: 			}
100: 		})
101: 	}
102: }
